topic.title: Search Bar & AI Chat Bot User Guide
topic.shortdesc: User guide for searching documentation using the header search bar and running the AI Chat Assistant interfaces.

section.title: Using the Search Bar
section.p: The documentation header includes an instant full-text search bar powered by MiniSearch:

ul.li: Instant Search Results — Click the search bar or press / to open the search modal. Type keywords to search topic titles, section headings, and body paragraphs.
Section Deep-Links — Click any search result item to jump directly to the matched section anchor within the topic.

fig.title: Interactive Search Bar and Instant Search Results Modal

section.title: Running the AI Chat Assistant
section.p: You can access the AI Assistant using two containerized deployment options:
Launch the React Harness stack using Docker Compose with your AI credentials in .env:
section.codeblock:
# Set your AI credentials in .env CHAT_BOT_PROVIDER=gemini GEMINI_API_KEY=your_api_key
# Launch with Docker Compose docker compose up -d
section.p: Open your browser to http://localhost:3000/chat to start using the assistant.
Launch the standalone chatbot container on port 3200 using a single Docker command:

section.title: Chat Interaction Examples
section.p: The AI Assistant chatbot handles user queries by dynamically selecting between two primary interaction models based on the intent of the prompt: Text Q&A Reasoning and Interactive Topic UI Rendering.
Sample User Question: "Is holly a good summer flower?" (or documentation-focused request: "Which documentation set could tell me 'is holly a good summer flower'?")

When you ask factual domain questions, the AI Assistant evaluates the query against loaded documentation sets, searches the corpus, and reads topic content (flowers/concepts/winterFlowers.json). It responds with clear text reasoning:

ul.li: Direct Answer: Clarifies that Holly (Holly berry) is a winter flower, not a summer flower.
Contextual Details: Notes that Holly blooms during winter (December–February in the Northern hemisphere).
Summer Recommendations: Recommends summer-blooming flowers from the corpus (Gardenia, Gerbera, Iris, Lilac, Rose, Salvia).

fig.title: Chat Interaction Example 1: Text Reasoning Response for "Is holly a good summer flower?"

p.b: Example 2: Interactive Topic UI Component Frame Interaction

section.p: Sample User Request: "Give me a page about Alerts"

When you ask to view a documentation page or component preview, the AI Assistant invokes the render_topic_ui tool. It embeds a live interactive topic component frame directly inside your conversation thread:

ul.li: Live Component Rendering: Displays interactive Alert components (alert-primary, alert-success, alert-danger) with dismiss buttons.
Code Samples: Shows DITA XML source markup snippets for authoring the component.
